en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
The blesbok wear no scarves and file no complaints. We could learn something. We won't, but we could.
The first sip after a 35-degree day should honestly be taxable.
The nearest neighbours are thirty kilometres away and tonight they can see you even less.
